data.title: Morgan Stanley sees AI IPO appetite building amid 'biggest capex cycle in our lifetimes'
data.description: Morgan Stanley Co-President Dan Simkowitz discusses investor appetite for AI IPOs, the scale of the industry's investment cycle and the importance of financial discipline under Nvidia's new leadership. He also sees a strong outlook for global M&A, supported by abundant credit and a favorable regulatory environment.
